budget_notes: Hire car for four days; fuel and the lighthouse entry are the only other costs (fixture).
intro: An invented island for testing: a four-day driving loop from Brackenford north to Gullhaven and south to Marrow Bay, with a ridge hike, a cliff-top overlook and two small villages.

practical.title: Driving
practical.text: Single-track roads north of Tollby; allow extra time and use passing places.
items: Fuel in Brackenford, Gullhaven and Marrow Bay only.

practical.title: Good to know
items: Gullhaven Lighthouse is closed on Mondays and Thursdays.
The north cape is a separate day trip.
